# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in DermacareVision AI, please report it responsibly.

- Open a private security advisory or contact the maintainers directly.
- Provide a detailed description of the vulnerability and steps to reproduce.
- Allow reasonable time for a fix before public disclosure.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
|---------|--------------------|
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |
